market_summary: During the London session, EURUSD and GBPUSD are recovering off session lows but remain bounded within their session Value Areas, testing overhead resistance near their respective Session Highs without volume breakout confirmation. BTCUSD remains in a structural downtrend below VWAP and VAL, but is presently stalling near local horizontal support levels without climactic volume, warranting a disciplined HOLD across all three assets.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluences: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (1.10773 - 1.10981) and trading right around POC (1.10946), close_vs_poc is slightly below; 2) CVD is BULLISH (+3,587 with positive slope +2,001.89), agreeing with the upward intraday recovery; 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, active liquidity; 4) Trend: Price is holding above VWAP (1.10847) and EMA50 (1.10878); 5) ATR band: Hovering near upper ATR band (1.10968) in a slight compression; 6) Volume: RVOL is normal (0.892, no yellow spikes), indicating lack of breakout impulse; 7) S/R: Testing right below Session High (1.10988) and VAH (1.10981). Since price is inside the value area and pressing against major overhead resistance without RVOL breakout volume, the probability of chop/mean reversion to POC is elevated. Confluence does not warrant a momentum scalp entry.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / price above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / holding near POC/VAH below Session High

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluences: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (1.32593 - 1.32797) and trading below POC (1.32738); 2) CVD is BEARISH (-2,610) with divergent positive short-term slope (+774.22), reflecting mixed order flow; 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, active; 4) Trend: Price is slightly above flat VWAP (1.32661) and straddling EMA50 (1.32693); 5) ATR band: Mid-to-upper channel below upper ATR band (1.32796); 6) Volume: RVOL is moderate (1.039, no recent spike); 7) S/R: Just rejected near Session High (1.32809) with a visible topping wick on the signal candle. With price caught inside Value Area, conflicting CVD signals, and trading right at the EMA50 baseline under overhead resistance, edge is insufficient.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / price above VWAP and testing EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / upper wick rejection near Session High

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluences: 1) Volume Profile: Price is breaking out below VAL (73416.41) and well below POC (73541.61), confirming value migration lower; 2) CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with negative slope (-0.01), aligned with the downtrend; 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION; 4) Trend: Price is firmly below VWAP (73625.7) and EMA50 (73640.0), with both trending downwards; 5) ATR band: Consolidating near lower ATR band (73123.4) after a prolonged grind down; 6) Volume: RVOL is 1.188 with zero yellow spikes, showing a slow drift without high-volume capitulation; 7) S/R: Hovering directly on top of minor support S/R at 73284.6 with Session Low (73166.0) just below. Selling directly into proximate S/R support after an extended move without an RVOL expansion or fresh pullback to EMA20/VAL carries adverse risk-reward. Awaiting cleaner breakout or pullback confirmation.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / price below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance / holding below VAL near support S/R 73284
